Pulse 0.11.6

What's new:
- Pin Pulse into a standalone floating window that stays above other apps and follows you across Spaces. The window remembers where you placed it, restores after relaunch, and safely returns to a visible display when monitors change.
- The pinned window uses native macOS toolbar controls for pinning, search, sharing, and more, while detail and settings pages keep their titles and navigation aligned in the content area.

What's improved:
- Moving between the watchlist, quotes, positions, trades, profiles, and settings now keeps the title bar and top content baseline stable. Window height changes animate in sync with page navigation, matching the smooth feel of the menu-bar panel.
- Opening the menu-bar panel and pinned window together now shares one live market-data session instead of starting duplicate refresh work.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.11.6.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
